verdict.rationale: There are only indirect signals of data portability and an exit path. A separate open-source Python library lets you run the agent locally instead of on the cloud. Run results come back as strings you can request as JSON, and run events can be polled through the API, so per-run data is retrievable programmatically. Nothing documents a full account export of sessions, run history or saved profiles in open formats. missing for 10: a documented bulk or account-wide data export, open-format export of saved profiles and session history, a documented migration path off the cloud, and independent corroboration.
